title: Use stdlib sqlite3 with plain SQL migration files instead of SQLAlchemy/Alembic
context: Issue #1 asks for migrations, a unique indexed short_code, and access methods. Only Flask is installed; no ORM is present.
options: SQLAlchemy + Alembic: full-featured migrations and DB portability, but two heavy dependencies for one table
stdlib sqlite3 + numbered .sql files with a tiny runner tracked in schema_migrations: zero dependencies, transparent SQL
Create schema on startup with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS: simplest, but not real migrations
why: One table does not justify an ORM; the runner is ~20 lines, applies each file atomically and is idempotent. Swapping to Postgres later would mean revisiting this.

title: Explicit named UNIQUE INDEX on short_code rather than a column UNIQUE constraint
context: Issue requires both uniqueness and an index on short_code.
options: UNIQUE column constraint: implicit auto-named index
Explicit CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_links_short_code: one object satisfies both, with a stable name tests and future migrations can refer to
why: Same enforcement and lookup performance, but the index is visible and verifiable (the test checks the query plan uses it).

anchors.snippet: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_links_short_code ON links (short_code);

title: Model expiry as nullable expires_at and disabling as a boolean flag; check usability in Python
context: Acceptance criteria require expired and disabled links be identifiable; issue #4 needs to reject them on redirect.
options: Status enum column (active/disabled/expired): expiry would need a background job to flip status
Nullable expires_at + disabled flag, with Link.is_usable() and a list_unusable() query: expiry is evaluated at read time
why: Expiry is time-based, so computing it at read time avoids a sweeper job. Timestamps are stored as UTC ISO-8601 text, which sorts correctly for the SQL comparison; naive datetimes are rejected to avoid timezone bugs.

title: Configure the database via SHORTY_DATABASE_PATH / SHORTY_DATABASE_TIMEOUT env vars
context: Issue asks for configurable connection settings.
options: DATABASE_URL connection string: conventional, but implies multi-backend support we do not have
Prefixed env vars mapped to a frozen DatabaseConfig dataclass, default ./shorty.db
why: Matches what SQLite actually takes (a path and a lock timeout) and keeps config injectable for tests.
